description:
Add a custom static HTML page to the Jitsi Meet web container so that navigating to http://localhost:8080/guidelines in the browser displays a meeting guidelines page.

Create an HTML file named guidelines.html with these requirements:
- Page title (<title> tag): 'Meeting Guidelines - Acme Corp'
- An <h1> heading: 'Acme Corp Meeting Guidelines'
- A section with <h2> heading 'Before the Meeting' containing a list with items:
  * 'Test your audio and video before joining'
  * 'Join from a quiet location with stable internet'
- A section with <h2> heading 'During the Meeting' containing a list with items:
  * 'Mute your microphone when not speaking'
  * 'Use the raise hand feature before speaking'
  * 'Keep your camera on during team meetings'
- A section with <h2> heading 'After the Meeting' containing a list with item:
  * 'Share meeting notes in the team channel'
- A link back to '/' with link text 'Start a Meeting'

Steps:
1. Create the HTML file with the above content
2. Copy it into the Jitsi web container at /usr/share/jitsi-meet/guidelines.html
3. Modify the Nginx config in the web container to add a location block serving /guidelines from this file
4. Reload Nginx in the web container (do not restart the entire container)
5. Verify by navigating to http://localhost:8080/guidelines in Firefox
6. Save a backup of the HTML file to /home/ga/guidelines.html

required_strings: Test your audio and video before joining
Join from a quiet location with stable internet
Mute your microphone when not speaking
Use the raise hand feature before speaking
Keep your camera on during team meetings
Share meeting notes in the team channel
